Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing donation of unclaimed personal property to nonprofit charitable organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to donation of unclaimed personal property tononprofit charitable organizations; amending RCW 63.32.050 and63.40.060; and adding a new section to chapter 63.35 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 63.32.050 and 1987 c 182 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to any other method of disposition of unclaimedproperty provided under this chapter, the police authorities of a cityor town may donate unclaimed ((bicycles, tricycles, and toys)) personalproperty to nonprofit charitable organizations ((for use by)). Anonprofit charitable organization receiving personal property donatedunder this section must use the property, or its proceeds, to benefitneedy persons.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 63.35 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to any other method of disposition of unclaimedproperty provided under this chapter, the state patrol may donateunclaimed personal property to nonprofit charitable organizations. A p. 1 HB 1145nonprofit charitable organization receiving personal property donatedunder this section must use the property, or its proceeds, to benefitneedy persons.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 63.40.060 and 1987 c 182 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to any other method of disposition of unclaimedproperty provided under this chapter, the county sheriff may donateunclaimed ((bicycles, tricycles, and toys)) personal property tononprofit charitable organizations ((for use by)). A nonprofitcharitable organization receiving personal property donated under thissection must use the property, or its proceeds, to benefit needypersons.
